claims: Real Madrid defeated MoraBanc Andorra on April 5, 2026.
The game was a Liga ACB basketball game.
The game was held at the Movistar Arena.
Real Madrid overcame an 18-point halftime deficit.
The victory secured Real Madrid's 11th consecutive league victory.
The game was part of the 25th round of the Liga Endesa.
Real Madrid maintained their lead in the Liga ACB standings.
Real Madrid holds a 23-win record in the domestic competition.
This win marked the 11th straight league win for Real Madrid against Andorra
